professionalSummary.text: Project manager on a bank's wealth platform onboarding programme for three years, running onboarding projects for two regions under the bank's delivery framework with migration plans and adviser training schedules.
professionalSummary.witness: Project manager on a bank's wealth platform onboarding programme for three years, running the onboarding projects for two regions under the bank's delivery framework with their migration plans and adviser training schedules.

experienceHighlights.text: Steered two regions' senior advisers through migration under the programme's adviser engagement plan, with engagement log recording 58 objections resolved and both regions' migration completed with all advisers onboarded on schedule.
experienceHighlights.witness: Steered the two regions' senior advisers through the migration under the programme's adviser engagement plan; the engagement log records the fifty-eight adviser objections raised, the resolution of each, and the two regions' migration completed with every adviser onboarded on schedule.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared weekly steering report for head of wealth change and managed dependencies with platform vendor and adviser operations through framework's dependency log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of wealth change and managed the dependencies with the platform vendor and adviser operations through the framework's dependency log.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared migration readiness review for each migration wave, with go-ahead by regional wealth director recorded on review alongside responsibility boundaries for checks.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the migration readiness review for each migration wave; the go-ahead was the regional wealth director's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were adviser operations'.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote closure report for each region with project boundary statement and client migration evidence accepted by programme office.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the closure report for each region with the project boundary statement and the client migration evidence accepted by the programme office.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes one migration plan with training schedule, adviser engagement log extract, readiness review with director's go-ahead, and closure report with programme office references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one migration plan with its training schedule, the adviser engagement log extract for one region, one readiness review with the director's go-ahead and one closure report, with the programme office references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Experience with bank's delivery framework for wealth platform onboarding projects.
skills.witness: Project manager on a bank's wealth platform onboarding programme for three years, running the onboarding projects for two regions under the bank's delivery framework with their migration plans and adviser training schedules.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with the bank's delivery framework, migration plans, adviser training schedules, engagement log, steering reports, dependency management, readiness reviews, and closure reports. The materials do not establish whether the candidate personally resolved all 58 objections or whether the regional wealth director's go-ahead was consistently granted.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to interview note suggesting potential challenges with steering senior advisers.

evidence.text: Project manager on a bank's wealth platform onboarding programme for three years, running the onboarding projects for two regions under the bank's delivery framework with their migration plans and adviser training schedules.

Steered the two regions' senior advisers through the migration under the programme's adviser engagement plan; the engagement log records the fifty-eight adviser objections raised, the resolution of each, and the two regions' migration completed with every adviser onboarded on schedule.
Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of wealth change and managed the dependencies with the platform vendor and adviser operations through the framework's dependency log.

Prepared the migration readiness review for each migration wave; the go-ahead was the regional wealth director's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were adviser operations'.
Wrote the closure report for each region with the project boundary statement and the client migration evidence accepted by the programme office.
